snippet.title: Haunted Bloodlines - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
Can you survive a house that is alive?

Haunted Bloodlines is a first-person psychological horror experience where you explore a shifting mansion filled with secrets, illusions, and hidden horrors.

Uncover the truth behind a cursed lineage while trying to keep your sanity intact.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2725610/Haunted_Bloodlines/

🕯️ About the Game

🏚️ A Living Mansion
• Explore a house that changes and evolves
• Hidden paths and shifting environments

👁️ Psychological Horror
• Experience tension, fear, and distorted reality
• Face visions and unsettling events

🏃 Survival Gameplay
• No combat, only escape and hiding
• Every mistake can be fatal

🧠 Sanity System
• Your perception changes as you explore
• Reality becomes harder to trust

⏳ Dual Realities
• Travel between the living world and a haunted version
• Use both dimensions to uncover secrets

📖 A Dark Legacy
• Discover the story of a cursed bloodline
• Uncover hidden truths buried in the past

⚠️ Content Warning
This game contains psychological horror elements, intense atmosphere, and disturbing themes.
